categories.name: Laddus

categories.name: Spice Mixes / Masala

products.name: Traditional Udid Papad
products.description: Authentic Maharashtrian Udid Papad hand-rolled by Nashik SHG women using premium quality black gram lentils, black pepper and sajji khar. Sun-dried naturally for that quintessential crispiness.
products.description_mr: नाशिक महिला बचत गटाने दर्जेदार उडीद डाळ, काळे मिरे आणि हिंग वापरून हाताने लाटलेले व कडक उन्हात वाळवलेले कुरकुरीत उडीद पापड.
products.description_hi: नासिक महिला समूह द्वारा हाथ से बेले गए और प्राकृतिक धूप में सुखाए गए कुरकुरे उड़द दाल पापड़।

products.name: Steamed Rice Papad (Tandul)
products.description: Thin, melt-in-the-mouth rice papads steamed in traditional bamboo sieves and sun-dried. When fried, they expand to twice their size with a delicate crunch.
products.description_mr: पारंपरिक पद्धतीने वाफेवर शिजवून उन्हात वाळवलेले पातळ व खमंग तांदळाचे पापड.
products.description_hi: पारंपरिक भाप में पकाए गए और धूप में सुखाए गए पतले और खस्ता चावल के पापड़।
products.ingredients: ["Indrayani Rice Flour","Cumin Seeds (Jeera)","Green Chillies","Rock Salt","Sesame Seeds"]

products.name: Spicy Masala Udid Papad
products.description: Infused with roasted cumin seeds, crushed black peppercorns and red chilli flakes. Perfect evening tea-time accompaniment or dinner side.
products.description_mr: भाजलेले जिरे, काळी मिरी आणि लाल तिखटाचा ठसका असलेले चटपटीत मसाला पापड.
products.description_hi: भुना हुआ जीरा, काली मिर्च और लाल मिर्च से भरपूर तीखा मसाला पापड़।

products.name: Traditional Kairi (Mango) Pickle
products.description: Handcrafted with raw Rajapuri green mangoes harvested from local orchards near Nashik. Blended with stone-ground mustard seeds, fenugreek, and cold-pressed groundnut oil, matured slowly in ceramic martabans.
products.description_mr: स्थानिक नाशिकच्या बागेतील राजापुरी कैरी, मोहरीची डाळ, मेथी आणि शुद्ध शेंगदाणा तेलात बरणीत मुरवलेले खमंग लोणचे.
products.description_hi: राजापुरी आम, राई की दाल और शुद्ध मूंगफली तेल में चीनी-मिट्टी की बरनी में पकाया गया पारंपरिक अचार।
products.ingredients: ["Raw Rajapuri Mango","Mustard Seeds","Fenugreek","Cold-Pressed Groundnut Oil","Turmeric","Red Chilli Powder","Rock Salt"]

products.name: Sweet & Tangy Lemon Pickle (Limboo)
products.description: Zero oil traditional recipe! Juicy Nashik lemons naturally preserved with organic jaggery, black rock salt, and warming spices. Aged under the sun for 40 days.
products.description_mr: तेलमुक्त पारंपरिक पद्धतीचे! नाशिकचे रसाळ लिंबू, सेंद्रिय गूळ आणि सैंधव मिठात उन्हात मुरवलेले रुचकर लोणचे.
products.description_hi: बिना तेल के शुद्ध गुड़ और सेंधा नमक में धूप में ४० दिन तक पकाया गया खट्टा-मीठा नींबू का अचार।
products.ingredients: ["Juicy Nashik Lemons","Organic Jaggery (Gul)","Black Salt","Kashmiri Red Chilli","Roasted Cumin"]

products.name: Kolhapuri Green Chilli Thecha
products.description: Coarsely pounded hot green chillies, garlic cloves, roasted cumin and peanuts in pure groundnut oil. The authentic Maharashtrian village fire in every spoonful.
products.description_mr: खलबत्त्यात कुटलेली तिखट हिरवी मिरची, लसूण, भाजलेले शेंगदाणे आणि जिरे यांचा अस्सल गावरान ठेचा.
products.description_hi: सिलबट्टे पर कुटी हुई हरी मिर्च, लहसुन और भुनी मूंगफली का प्रामाणिक महाराष्ट्रीयन ठेचा।
products.ingredients: ["Fresh Green Chillies","Desi Garlic","Roasted Peanuts","Cumin Seeds","Groundnut Oil","Salt"]

products.name: Special Bhajani Chakli (Multi-Grain)
products.description: The pride of Jijamata Gruh Udyog! Multi-grain flour made of roasted rice, chana dal, udid dal, coriander seeds and cumin. Deep-fried in fresh sunflower oil to crunchy, spiral perfection.
products.description_mr: तांदूळ, चणा डाळ, उडीद डाळ, धणे व जिरे मंद आचेवर भाजून तयार केलेल्या घरगुती भाजणीची कुरकुरीत व खमंग चकली.
products.description_hi: भुने हुए अनाज और दालों से बनी प्रामाणिक खस्ता और सुगंधित चकली।
products.ingredients: ["Bhajani Flour (Rice, Chana Dal, Udid Dal, Moong)","Coriander Seeds","Cumin","White Sesame (Til)","Ajwain","Vegetable Oil","Spices"]

products.name: Poha Butter Chakli (Melt-in-Mouth)
products.description: Light, non-greasy and delicate snack made with beaten rice flakes (poha), white butter and roasted sesame seeds. Loved by children and elders alike.
products.description_mr: नाशिकच्या दर्जेदार पोह्यांपासून व लोण्यापासून बनवलेली तोंडात विरघळणारी हलकी-फुलकी चकली.
products.description_hi: पोहा और मक्खन से तैयार हल्की, कुरकुरी और स्वादिष्ट चकली।
products.ingredients: ["Roasted Poha Flour","Rice Flour","White Butter","Sesame Seeds","Cumin","Mild Spices"]

products.name: Pure Ghee Besan Laddus (Danedar)
products.name_hi: शुद्ध घी के दानेदार बेसन लड्डू
products.description: Slow-roasted gram flour in 100% pure desi cow ghee until golden amber, garnished with green cardamom, crunchy cashews and almonds. Pure home-style goodness.
products.description_mr: शुद्ध गावरान तुपात मंद आचेवर गुलाबी होईपर्यंत भाजलेले दाणेदार बेसन, वेलची पूड आणि बदाम-काजूयुक्त चवदार लाडू.
products.description_hi: शुद्ध देसी घी में धीमी आंच पर भुने हुए दानेदार बेसन, इलायची और मेवे से भरपूर लड्डू।
products.ingredients: ["Coarse Gram Flour (Besan)","Pure Desi Cow Ghee","Bura Sugar","Cardamom Powder","Cashews","Almonds"]

products.name: Nutritious Ragi & Jaggery Laddus (Nachni)
products.name_hi: पौष्टिक रागी और गुड़ के लड्डू
products.description: Healthy and wholesome sweet packed with calcium and iron. Made from locally harvested Nashik finger millet (nachni), organic jaggery, and crushed dry fruits in pure cow ghee.
products.description_mr: सेंद्रिय नाचणी, सेंद्रिय गूळ आणि सुका मेवा वापरून बनवलेले लोह आणि कॅल्शियमने समृद्ध पौष्टिक लाडू.
products.description_hi: नासिक की रागी, जैविक गुड़ और मेवों से भरपूर स्वास्थ्यवर्धक लड्डू।
products.ingredients: ["Sprouted Ragi (Nachni) Flour","Organic Jaggery","Pure Cow Ghee","Dry Dates Powder (Kharik)","Almonds"]

products.name: Traditional Dink (Edible Gum) Laddus
products.name_hi: गोंद और सूखे मेवे के लड्डू
products.description: Winter and post-partum traditional superfood recipe. Made with crunchy fried edible gum (dink), grated dried coconut, roasted poppy seeds, dates and dry fruits in pure cow ghee.
products.description_mr: तळलेला डिंक, खोबरे, खसखस, खारीक आणि भरपूर सुका मेवा शुद्ध तुपात तयार केलेले शक्तिवर्धक डिंकाचे लाडू.
products.description_hi: गोंद, सूखा नारियल, खसखस और मेवों से बने पारंपरिक शक्तिवर्धक लड्डू।
products.ingredients: ["Edible Gum (Dink)","Dry Coconut","Dry Dates Powder","Pure Cow Ghee","Poppy Seeds","Organic Jaggery","Dry Fruits"]

products.name: Authentic Nashik Goda Masala
products.description: The soul of Maharashtrian cuisine! 24 traditional whole spices slowly roasted with stone flowers (dagad phool), sesame, and grated dry coconut. Essential for authentic Amti, Dal and Usal.
products.description_mr: दगडफूल, तीळ, सुके खोबरे आणि २४ सुगंधी मसाल्यांची मंद आचेवर भाजणी करून खलबत्त्यात कुटलेला अस्सल गोडा मसाला.
products.description_hi: पत्थर के फूल, तिल और २४ मसालों के मिश्रण से बना सुगंधित पारंपरिक गोडा मसाला।
products.ingredients: ["Coriander Seeds","Cumin","Stone Flower (Dagad Phool)","Dry Coconut","White Sesame","Star Anise","Cinnamon","Cloves"]

products.name: Nashik Special Misal Masala (Zanzanit)
products.description: Recreate Nashik’s world-famous fiery, aromatic Misal pav kat/tarri right in your home kitchen. Perfectly roasted Bedgi and Lavangi chillies with aromatic whole garam masalas.
products.description_mr: नाशिकची जगप्रसिद्ध झणझणीत मिसळ आणि तर्री बनवण्यासाठी खास बेळगावी व लवंगी मिरच्यांपासून तयार केलेला मसाला.
products.description_hi: नासिक की मशहूर तीखी और स्वादिष्ट मिसल तरी बनाने के लिए विशेष मसाला मिश्रण।

products.name: Gavran Kanda Lasun Masala (Onion-Garlic)
products.description: Slow-fried Nashik red onions and desi garlic blended with stone-ground red chillies and whole spices. Brings rich color, thick gravy and robust aroma to any vegetable or curry.
products.description_mr: नाशिकचा लाल कांदा व गावठी लसूण तेलात सोनेरी तळून मसाल्यांसोबत एकत्र केलेला चवदार कांदा लसूण मसाला.
products.description_hi: नासिक के प्याज और देसी लहसुन के साथ पिसा हुआ पारंपरिक कांदा-लहसुन मसाला।
products.ingredients: ["Nashik Red Onions","Garlic Cloves","Red Chilli Powder","Coriander Seeds","Turmeric","Cinnamon","Oil"]

products.name: Kanda Lasun Chutney
products.description: Fiery Kolhapuri-style dry onion garlic chutney made by Nashik SHG women.

reviews.comment: Reminds me exactly of my grandmother’s Diwali preparation! Crisp, not too oily, and the roasted bhajani aroma is completely authentic. Highly recommend!
The traditional ceramic jar aging really makes a difference. No chemical taste, just pure cold-pressed oil and fragrant mustard. My whole family loves it.
Danedar texture and real cow ghee aroma! As a Nashik local, I am so proud of Jijamata Gruh Udyog women sisters for this high standard.
This Goda Masala transformed our daily Katachi Amti and Bharli Vangi. It has that true traditional black spice depth you never find in store-bought packets.
